purpose: Close the semantic gap between local storage identities and instruction-result values before the general emitter. Mutable locals and fixed arrays are modeled as storage; reads create result values and writes consume source values, so the emitter never reconstructs a current value from raw source.

storage_model.parameter: immutable semantic value available at function entry
storage_model.scalar_local: stable LOCAL_STORAGE_IDENTITY; reading requires LOAD_LOCAL -> fresh instruction result; writing requires STORE_LOCAL(local_id, source_value_id)
storage_model.fixed_array_local: stable LOCAL_STORAGE_IDENTITY with element type and fixed extent; element reads require LOAD_INDEX(array_local_id, index_value_id) -> fresh result; element writes require STORE_INDEX(array_local_id, index_value_id, source_value_id)
storage_model.compound_assignment: lower to explicit load + arithmetic/comparison operation + store; no implicit mutable-current-value lane
storage_model.array_initializer: must lower deterministically either to FIXED_ARRAY_INIT or to a verified ordered sequence of element stores
storage_model.phi_policy: SSA phi nodes are not required for mutable local storage itself. Instruction-result values remain single-definition values; control-flow joins observe locals through explicit loads from storage.

array_requirements: index expression is a semantic value ID, never a raw-source token
element type is derived from verified local metadata
fixed extent is preserved in local metadata
verifier proves statically-known constant indices are in range
dynamic indices remain runtime checked or follow the bootstrap language's separately documented bounds policy
STORE_INDEX source type equals array element type
LOAD_INDEX result type equals array element type

definition_kinds.LOAD_RESULT: defined by LOAD_LOCAL or LOAD_INDEX instruction
definition_kinds.CALL_RESULT: defined by a result-producing call instruction

use_rules: every operand references a populated semantic value header, never an extension-only physical slot
parameter values may only be used by their owning function
local storage identities may only be accessed by instructions owned by the same function
instruction-result values have exactly one defining instruction
instruction-result definitions dominate every use under the final CFG; constants and parameters are entry-available
STORE_LOCAL/STORE_INDEX do not redefine the local identity and do not fabricate a second semantic value
CALL arguments preserve source/lowering order and reference semantic value IDs
RETURN_VALUE references a defined value compatible with function return type
CONDITIONAL_BRANCH references a defined condition value and same-function target blocks
verifier_order: decode and range-check all value headers
decode and range-check all local/parameter metadata
decode blocks and establish block-to-function ownership
decode instructions in deterministic block order
establish exactly-one definition for each instruction-result value
validate storage accesses and array shapes
reject any unreferenced wide-literal extension slot presented as a semantic value ID
reject overflow, truncation, namespace collision, or source reconstruction
fail_closed_cases: direct local read with no LOAD_LOCAL
direct array element use with no LOAD_INDEX
instruction result referenced before or outside its valid CFG definition
same semantic result ID defined by more than one instruction
constant out-of-range index when statically knowable
call argument references storage identity where a loaded scalar value is required
return or branch condition references storage identity where a scalar value is required
